absenceClasses.definition: The target lies outside the geographic, institutional, chronological, or generic scope of the witness.
The target is named in another passage, sheet, recension, or source-level context but not at the focal locator.
The witness's purpose or declared scope does not address the historical question.
A reviewed witness whose scope includes the question does not name the target.
The project has not inspected the defined witness or sample.
Loss, incomplete survival, cataloguing, digitisation, or sampling prevents a source-level absence decision.
